items.headline: IceCure Medical Says JHM-IRB Of West Cancer Center & Research Institute In Germantown, Tennessee, Approves Post-Marketing Study For ProSense Cryoablation In Local Treatment Of Low-Risk Breast Cancer
items.summary: Patients are expected to enroll in the post-marketing study in the coming weeks, following approval from the Institutional Review Board of West Cancer Center & Research Institute in Germantown, TNCAESAREA, Israel,
